trades.thesis: Q3 beat and raise: revenue +24% with all regions and segments double-digit (Greater China +30%), adjusted gross margin +150bp, adj EPS 0.42 vs ~0.34-0.35 consensus, FY26 EPS guide 1.32-1.35 above 1.31 consensus, $1B buyback authorised (about 6% of cap). The stock fell five straight sessions into the print (32.46 to 29.10), so positioning was bearish; post-earnings drift from an oversold base. Risk: gap fade, tariffs, macro/NVDA tonight.
